scope: Selected verbatim accessibility excerpts from the completed correction. Not a full transcript; not source review or execution.
excerpts: Memory Pressure and Unprofiled Hardware Mechanics:  With active MLX weights occupying ~9 GiB within an 18. 1 GiB available envelope,  claims of resident-model memory thrashing are withdrawn.  Unprofiled attributions to memory-bandwidth saturation and GEMV/GEMM reduction-tree disparities are likewise withdrawn.

Numerical Guarantees and Hybrid Oracle Flaws:  Assertions that FP32  will  diverge on untested prompts,  or that matching reduction tiling alone guarantees bitwise identity across all kernels and cache states,  are withdrawn.  Furthermore,  previous-token logit margins do not bound subsequent token errors,  and re-running a block in FP32 over a native-precision KV cache cannot restore a valid serial oracle because the conditioning history is already altered.
coordinator_note: Resource figures refer to different observation points; they are not proof of an idle host. Global load and swap telemetry remain in the measured dataset.
